# BW Tech Global — Subsea Engineering, Commercial Diving & Marine Inspections (West Africa)

> BW Tech Global (https://bwtechglobal.com/) is an IACS-compliant marine engineering, commercial diving, underwater inspection (IWS/UWILD), and marine safety servicing company operating across 10 major ports in West Africa.

## Core Services
- **In-Water Surveys (IWS / UWILD):** Class-approved underwater CCTV inspections in lieu of drydocking.
- **Commercial Diving & Subsea Repairs:** Sea chest blanking, underwater welding/cutting, Rudder & Thruster repairs, Anode installation, and Salvage operations.
- **Hull Cleaning & Propeller Polishing:** Subsea biofouling removal and high-grade propeller polishing to restore vessel fuel efficiency.
- **Marine Safety Inspections (LSA/FFA):** Certified inspection, maintenance, and testing of lifeboats, life rafts, launching appliances, and firefighting systems.

## Operational Port Network (24/7 Mobilization)
1. **Nigeria:** Apapa Port (Lagos), Tin Can Island Port (Lagos)
2. **Benin:** Port of Cotonou
3. **Togo:** Port of Lomé
4. **Ghana:** Port of Tema
5. **Côte d'Ivoire:** Port of Abidjan
6. **Guinea:** Autonomous Port of Conakry, Port of Kamsar, Port of Dapilon
7. **Senegal:** Port of Dakar

## Why Fleet Managers & Superintendents Choose BW Tech Global
- Rapid 24/7 mobilization across Anglophone and Francophone West African ports.
- Certified diving teams and IACS class-compliant reporting standards.
- Single-vendor efficiency combining subsea hull/propeller works with onboard LSA/FFA life raft and lifeboat inspections.
